title: Yahova Maaku Thodugaa – Sathish Kumar Telugu Christian Lyrics
telugu: యెహోవా మాకు తోడుగా – యేసయ్యా మా ఇంట ఉండగా

కమనీయమైన నీ ప్రేమ బంధం – కాచింది కనుపాపలా

english: Yahovaa maaku thodugaa – Yesayya maa inta undagaa
Edabaayaledhe nee krupa mammu – vidanaada ledhennadu

krupa vembadi krupatho nimpaavu mammu – kashtaala kanneellalo
intro: Yahova Maaku Thodugaa is the latest Christian Telugu song from the album, Nee Sannidhi Chaalunayaa written, tuned & sung by pastor, singer, song-writer, preacher, evangelist, Dr P Satish Kumar. This song video was released on January 08, 2021 through Calvary Temple Youtube Channel.
